description:
What breaks if you change a function, file or module.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You're about to change a signature, refactor or delete code
• You need callers or detected endpoints a change reaches

RETURNS: Risk, production callers by module/file, endpoints, cron jobs and DB operations. Hops are the shortest detected path within the requested depth (1–5). Test-file callers are excluded.

USE INSTEAD OF: following callers by hand.

depth.description: How many hops to trace (default: 3, range: 1–5)

entity.description: Function name, file path, or module name

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: get_blast_radius
